name: – Evin Incir, Joanna Scheuring-Wielgus – After § 7 – Am 3
title: REPORT on the importance of consent-based rape legislation in the EU
part_text: 7b. Calls on the Commission to assess, as a matter of priority, the inclusion of the offence of sexual abuse, defined, in line with international human rights standards and the Istanbul Convention, on the basis of lack of consent, among the list of offences set out in Article 2(2) of the Council Framework Decision of 13 June 2002 on the European arrest warrant and the surrender procedures between Member States (2002/584/JHA), for which the verification of double criminality is abolished; stresses that this inclusion would strengthen the principle of mutual recognition, facilitate the immediate surrender of suspects and convicted persons across the Member States, and contribute to addressing the current fragmentation of national definitions of sexual abuse, thereby reinforcing legal certainty and equal access to justice for victims throughout the EU;
